subject.title: fix: protect SMS webhook callback quota [AI]

question: Is the current-head same-key and validation-disabled runtime proof required before this protected SMS security-boundary PR can merge?
rationale: The source and tests are convincing, but the only posted real HTTP run predates the commits that changed those exact behaviors, and the maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Require current-head proof
options.body: Ask for one redacted Crabbox HTTP transcript covering same-key valid-after-invalid behavior and the validation-disabled request cap before merge.

options.title: Accept tests plus earlier proof
options.body: Treat the earlier proxy run and final focused tests as sufficient evidence for the later narrow changes.

recommendation.title: Require current-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for one redacted Crabbox HTTP transcript covering same-key valid-after-invalid behavior and the validation-disabled request cap before merge.
